title: lint: a same-file ESLint rule for AGENTS.md commandment #10 (depending on a useMemo/useCallback identity) — a partial net that catches 4 of the 8 ruled instances
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` execution seat (`session_01MCLBsUgfykL74aU716rzVK`, GitHub `os-sales`) as the follow-up that objectui#8640's rule (`AGENTS.md` §5 commandment #10, objectui PR #9257) names as feasible. ⛔ No `domain:*` label: routing is the triage seat's (the landing point is `eslint-rules/` — objectui code, not a governed surface).

## The ask

A same-file ESLint rule over the shape commandment #10 forbids: a `useMemo` / `useCallback` result used as a `useEffect` / `useMemo` dependency, as a `Map` / `WeakMap` key, or in a reference comparison, within one module.

## The measured reach — a partial net, stated as such

The feasibility reading on objectui#8640's PR (dev report on that card) over the eight instances the rule was ruled on:

| would have caught | would have missed (crosses a module boundary) |
|---|---|
| objectui#6018 · #6592 · #6697 · #6862 | objectui#5976 (value never memoised — the inverse shape) · #6591 (a prop) · #6724 (a hook return) · #6813 (a context) |

⇒ 4 of 8. ⛔ This card does not retire the class; it removes the same-file half of it mechanically, and the rule text already says the rest is out of any single-file rule's reach.

## Constraints measured by that reading

- `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` is live at `warn` via `reactHooks.configs.recommended.rules` (eslint-plugin-react-hooks 7.1.1) and overlaps the dependency-list half; the new rule must not double-report or contradict it.
- The React-Compiler-era rules (`preserve-manual-memoization` is the nearest neighbour) are downgraded to `warn` in `eslint.config.js` with the reason 「codebase predates these rules」 — a decision this card does not reopen.
- `eslint-rules/` already hosts repo-local rules; objectui#6592's census ran this exact sweep by hand once, so a corpus for the rule's fixtures exists.

## Acceptance

- The rule fires on the four same-file instances' shapes (fixtures reconstructed from their diffs) and stays silent on the four cross-boundary ones by construction (documented in the rule's header, not by an ignore list).
- Zero new reports on `origin/main` at the time of landing, or each report triaged in the PR body.
- The rule's header names commandment #10 as its authority and states the boundary it cannot cross.

Refs: objectui#8640 · objectui PR #9257 · objectui#6592 (the hand census) · objectui#6813 / #6862 (the seam).
